description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/advection_2d_x_zero_grad_central.esm (model Advection2DxZeroGrad, test mms_steady_x_zero_grad) at the problem's default resolution (NX=64, NY edge-bound to 8) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Exercises the second-order centered first-derivative rule central_D1x_zero_grad_bc (2nd-order one-sided x-faces) on the full 2-D field. The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

rust._doc: Deterministic Erk-vs-Tsit5 integrator-method disagreement on a floor-sensitive time-integrated functional: mms_steady_x_zero_grad[2] rel 2.87e-08 / abs 1.09e-12 (ref 3.799341e-05). MEASURED 2026-10-19 against EarthSciAST 34f064149; the values match the 2026-07-28 EarthSciAST dc76c5bf measurement, so this is the same method-disagreement floor that previously blocked the case for rust (rust already ran it in seconds), now admitted as a measured band instead of a block; the inline assertions pass at the problem-file tolerances, so only the cross-binding re-evaluation band is widened (10x headroom, decade-rounded). Re-tighten if the bindings ever pin the same integrator.
